Messages.Author: Cheesecake
Messages.Body:
My opponent play Blood Rage. My weapon strike for this strike is 0 because
of his strike. If I do 2 additional strikes are they also reduced to 0?

Now supposed I dodged his Blood Rage. Will my additional strikes with a
weapon this round hit normally? (not reduced to 0?)

Thanks!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cheesecake wrote:
>
> My opponent play Blood Rage. My weapon strike for this strike is 0 because
> of his strike. If I do 2 additional strikes are they also reduced to 0?

Yes. Card text: "If the opposing vampire attempts to strike
with a weapon this round, he or she does no damage."

> Now supposed I dodged his Blood Rage. Will my additional strikes with a
> weapon this round hit normally? (not reduced to 0?)

Yes. If you dodge a strike, the strike doesn't affect you.
